---
title: Penguins Dataset in R
format: html
author: "Samuel Goughnour"
---
```{r}
library(palmerpenguins)
library(ggplot2)
#insert introduction commentary here
```
```{r}
ncol(penguins)
nrow(penguins)
pmale <- penguins[penguins$sex == "male",]
pfemale <- penguins[penguins$sex == "female",]
nrow(pmale)
nrow(pfemale)
#There are 179 male penguins and 176 female penguins. Pretty even split!
padel <- penguins[penguins$species == "Adelie",]
pchin <- penguins[penguins$species == "Chinstrap",]
pgen <- penguins[penguins$species == "Gentoo",]
nrow(padel)
nrow(pchin)
nrow(pgen)
#There are 152 Adelie penguins, 68 Chinstrap penguins, and 124 Gentoo penguins. The Adelie penguins are the most common species in this dataset.
ibis <- penguins[penguins$island == "Biscoe",]
idream <- penguins[penguins$island == "Dream",]
itorg <- penguins[penguins$island == "Torgersen",]
nrow(ibis)
nrow(idream)
nrow(itorg)
#There are 168 penguins on Biscoe, 124 penguins on Dream, and 124 penguins on Torgersen. Biscoe is the most common island in this dataset.
```
```{r}
ggplot(data = penguins, aes(x = sex, y = body_mass_g)) +
  geom_col(aes(color = species)) +
  labs(title = "Body Mass of Penguins by Sex",
       x = "Sex",
       y = "Body Mass (g)") +
  theme_minimal()

  ggplot(data = penguins, aes(x = island, y = species)) +
  geom_boxplot(aes(color = species), size = 3) +
  labs(title = "Penguin Species by Island",
       x = "Island",
       y = "Species") +
  theme_minimal()
```
